prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / targeted concept proportion revision.
Edit target Image 1: thieu-lam-concept-v01.png. Supporting reference Image 2: artwork/thieu-lam-thien-son.png, specifically the shaved-head gold-robed monk in the LOWER HALF. Supporting style references Images 3 and 4: approved Vo Dang and Thien Son concepts.
Create the v02 CONCEPT board by redrawing Image 1's exact same monk identity and two presentations in distinctly more compact CHIBI proportions, closer to the tiny monk silhouettes in Image 2. This is the only principal design change: enlarge the bald head and shorten the torso and legs so each complete standing monk measures approximately 2.5 to 2.75 head-heights from scalp to soles. The head should occupy about 36-40 percent of total character height. Keep broad sturdy shoulders, strong forearms, readable large hands and a squat planted martial stance. Do not keep the tall four-head proportions of Image 1.
Preserve: shaved head, calm stern thick brows, warm skin, saffron ochre cross-collar short-sleeved tunic and split robe panels, dark brown sash and edging, brown trousers, ivory wrist/shin wraps, dark cloth shoes, restrained wooden beads. Same costume, face, palette, lighting, proportions and accessories on both poses. One unarmed guarded stance and one supporting pose with a broad curved single-edged pale-steel dao held in the anatomical right hand, free left hand guarding. No staff or straight jian.
Redraw both bodies with the same clearly elevated orthographic THREE-QUARTER overworld viewpoint as Image 2's monk: visible scalp top and shoulders, mildly foreshortened body and short visible feet. No isometric diamond-grid, eye-level heroic illustration, 3D or side-view camera. Keep the unarmed guard and strong blade silhouette clear when imagined at small gameplay size.
Preserve detailed chibi wuxia pixel illustration quality with crisp stepped selective outlines and coherent pixel clusters, ochre cloth folds, warm brown shadows, soft upper-left daylight and restrained gold guard/material accents. Avoid noisy all-over dithering or blurry painterly brushwork. No magical aura, effects, armor, extra limbs or weapon.
Layout: square slate/blue-gray concept board with the two complete full-body variants separated side-by-side at the same scale, generous breathing room. Leave at least five percent canvas margin around EVERY head, hand, foot and blade tip. Keep the entire curved dao clearly inside the canvas and still substantial. Underneath, small restrained palette swatches. No words, labels, watermark, UI, environment or extra characters. Concept art only, not an animation atlas; never resize the illustration into production sprites.
